cases.name: Valerie Ann Street
cases.narrative: On 5/04/1980, her nude body was found under a motel room bed. Her hands were handcuffed behind her back, she had traces of adhesive tape around her mouth. There were bite marks on her breasts, body and head, in addition to minor knife incisions on her breasts. She was abducted from E. 25th Street in Manhattan, NYC and murdered in New Jersey.
